## `src/lib` — the shared rules

The rule each module owns, from its own header comment where it has one and
from §5 otherwise. The long-form reasoning is in
[`domain-rules.md`](domain-rules.md); the authority when the two disagree is
the file itself.

| Module | What it owns |
| --- | --- |

| [`actor.ts`](../src/lib/actor.ts) | Who is acting in the admin, and what they may reach. |
| [`audit.ts`](../src/lib/audit.ts) | The trail: what somebody did in an organizer's admin, and who. |

| [`blob.ts`](../src/lib/blob.ts) | Every upload. |
| [`brand-mark.ts`](../src/lib/brand-mark.ts) | The geometry of the Run As One mark, in one place. |
